newsitem.title: UK: Three corporate chiefs recognised in UK honours.
newsitem.headline: Three corporate chiefs recognised in UK honours.

text.p: The heads of three of Britain's largest companies received knighthoods in Queen Elizabeth's Birthday Honours list on Saturday.

Dominic Cadbury, chairman of Cadbury Schweppes Plc, Thomas Farmer, chairman and chief executive of Kwik-Fit Holdings Plc and John Jennings, chairman of Shell Transport & Trading Co Plc, will all be able to call themselves "Sir" from this weekend.

Professor Tim Congdon, managing director of Lombard Street Research and one of former Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke's independent advisers, or "wise men", is made a Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE).
